upgrade.description: Upgrade level. The weapon's own cap is checked by a postcondition; pass max_upgrade to have it checked before the node runs.

max_upgrade.description: This weapon's cap, copied from weapon-lookup.

attack_mv.description: Motion value of the attack, as a percentage. Default 100.

avg_pve.description: Average over the reference PvE targets instead of one. Default false.

counter_hit.description: Score the comparison on a counter hit. Default false.

defense.description: The target's defences. Omit for the calculator's standard PvE reference; the result says which was used.
